req.title: Location header on create
req.statement: The system shall set Location: /players/{new_id} on the 201 Created response.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should set the Location header correctly when a new player is created. This is crucial for RESTful APIs to provide clients with the URI of the newly created resource. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage of this functionality.

tests.name: test_create_player_location_header_positive
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new player with a unique squad number.
expected: The Location header is set to the correct URI format.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

new_player = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "New Team",
    "league": "New League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=new_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/players/squadnumber/27'

tests.name: test_create_player_location_header_negative
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new player with an existing squad number.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating conflict.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

existing_player = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Smith",
    "dateOfBirth": "1991-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 1,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Existing Team",
    "league": "Existing League",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=existing_player)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert "A Player with this squad number already exists." in response.json()['detail']

tests.name: test_create_player_location_header_boundary
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new player with the maximum length for string fields.
expected: The Location header is set to the correct URI format.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

boundary_player = {
    "firstName": "X" * 50,
    "middleName": "X" * 50,
    "lastName": "X" * 50,
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 28,
    "position": "X" * 30,
    "abbrPosition": "X" * 5,
    "team": "X" * 60,
    "league": "X" * 60,
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=boundary_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/players/squadnumber/28'
